#no prior
```{r}
# No ZT-prior ablation for 3999g_20000c time-point benchmark
# Purpose:
#   Compare standard 27-seed scRhythmBayes with ZT prior versus the same model without ZT prior.
#   No ZT-prior inference has arbitrary global circular phase, so CDF is evaluated before and after global alignment.
#   Scatter plots use simple titles: "ZT prior" and "No ZT prior".

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(data.table)
})

# Step 0. Load internal phase core

source("/Users/zhangqian/Desktop/scRhythmBayes/R/infer_cell_phase.R")

wrap24 <- function(x) {
  ((x %% 24) + 24) %% 24
}

circ_abs_err_h <- function(pred_h, true_h) {
  diff_h <- abs((pred_h - true_h) %% 24)
  pmin(diff_h, 24 - diff_h)
}

calc_phase_metrics <- function(true_h, pred_h) {
  err_h <- circ_abs_err_h(pred_h = pred_h, true_h = true_h)
  err_h <- sort(err_h)

  hrsoff <- c(0, err_h, 12)

  frac_wrong <- sapply(
    hrsoff,
    function(hrtol) {
      100 * sum(err_h > hrtol) / length(err_h)
    }
  )

  pct_correct <- 100 - frac_wrong
  norm_pct_correct <- pct_correct / 100
  norm_hrsoff <- hrsoff / 12

  auc <- sum(norm_pct_correct[-length(norm_pct_correct)] * diff(norm_hrsoff))
  medae <- median(err_h)

  list(
    AUC = auc,
    MedAE = medae,
    n_cell = length(err_h),
    threshold_h = hrsoff,
    pct_correct = pct_correct,
    err_h = err_h
  )
}

make_grid_cdf <- function(true_h, pred_h, threshold_grid) {
  err_h <- circ_abs_err_h(pred_h = pred_h, true_h = true_h)

  pct_correct <- sapply(
    threshold_grid,
    function(hrtol) {
      100 * sum(err_h <= hrtol) / length(err_h)
    }
  )

  tibble(
    threshold_h = threshold_grid,
    pct_correct = pct_correct
  )
}

find_best_global_shift <- function(true_h, pred_h, shift_grid = seq(0, 24, by = 0.01)) {
  medae_grid <- sapply(
    shift_grid,
    function(s) {
      median(
        circ_abs_err_h(
          pred_h = wrap24(pred_h + s),
          true_h = true_h
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }
  )

  best_id <- which.min(medae_grid)

  tibble(
    shift_h = shift_grid[best_id],
    MedAE = medae_grid[best_id]
  )
}

save_phase_scatter_with_wrapper <- function(
    res_phase,
    metadata,
    pred_by,
    title_text,
    point_col,
    out_pdf,
    out_tiff
) {
  res_tmp <- res_phase
  res_tmp$ZT_pred_plot <- res_tmp[[pred_by]]

  p_phase <- plot_phase_scatter(
    res_phase = res_tmp,
    metadata = metadata,
    truth_by = "t_true",
    pred_by = "ZT_pred_plot",
    point_col = point_col
  )

  if (!is.null(p_phase$plot)) {
    p_phase$plot <- p_phase$plot +
      ggplot2::ggtitle(title_text)
  }

  pdf(file = out_pdf, width = 3.2, height = 3.2)
  print(p_phase$plot)
  dev.off()

  tiff(
    filename = out_tiff,
    width = 3.2,
    height = 3.2,
    units = "in",
    res = 300,
    compression = "lzw"
  )
  print(p_phase$plot)
  dev.off()

  invisible(p_phase)
}

# Step 1. IO

benchmark_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_timepoint_number_3999g_20000c"

obj_dir <- file.path(benchmark_dir, "sim_objects")
standard_phase_dir <- file.path(benchmark_dir, "res_phase")

out_dir <- file.path(benchmark_dir, "benchmark_no_ZT_prior")
phase_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "res_phase")
plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots_cell_phase")
index_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "index")

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(phase_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(index_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

n_timepoint <- 24
rep_id <- 1
force_rerun_noprior <- FALSE

obj_file <- file.path(
  obj_dir,
  paste0("simulate_data_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_3999g_20000c.rds")
)

standard_phase_file <- file.path(
  standard_phase_dir,
  paste0("res_phase_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_rep", rep_id, ".rds")
)

noprior_file <- file.path(
  phase_dir,
  paste0("res_phase_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_rep", rep_id, "_NoZTPrior.rds")
)

stopifnot(file.exists(obj_file), file.exists(standard_phase_file))

# Step 2. Load data

obj_sim <- readRDS(obj_file)
DefaultAssay(obj_sim) <- "RNA"

count <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
  obj_sim,
  assay = "RNA",
  slot = "counts"
)

metadata <- obj_sim@meta.data %>%
  as.data.frame()

metadata$cell <- rownames(metadata)

stopifnot(identical(colnames(count), metadata$cell))
stopifnot(all(c("ZT_sym", "t_true", "theta_rad", "celltype") %in% colnames(metadata)))

message("Loaded object: ", obj_file)
message("Cells: ", ncol(count))
message("Genes: ", nrow(count))
message("Observed ZT: ", paste(sort(unique(as.numeric(metadata$ZT_sym))), collapse = ", "))
message("Celltypes:")
print(table(metadata$celltype))

# Step 3. Load 27 seed genes

load("~/scRhythmBayes/data/merge_27seedgenes_bmal1.Rdata")

seed27 <- unique(as.character(seed27_in))
seed27 <- seed27[!is.na(seed27)]
seed27 <- seed27[nzchar(seed27)]
seed27 <- seed27[seed27 %in% rownames(count)]

message("Matched seed genes: ", length(seed27))
print(seed27)

if (length(seed27) != 27) {
  stop("The number of matched seed genes is not 27.")
}

# Step 4. Run or load No ZT-prior model

zt <- as.numeric(metadata$ZT_sym)
zt <- wrap24(zt)

stratum <- as.character(metadata$celltype)

if (file.exists(noprior_file) && !force_rerun_noprior) {
  message("Existing No ZT-prior result found. Loading: ", noprior_file)
  res_phase_noprior <- readRDS(noprior_file)
} else {
  message("Running No ZT-prior model on 24-timepoint 3999g_20000c dataset.")

  res_phase_noprior <- .infer_cell_phase_core(
    Count = count,
    ZT = zt,
    Stratum = stratum,
    seedgene = seed27,
    Species = "mouse",
    SeedMode = "Custom",
    Mode = "NoPrior",
    n_grid = 60,
    n_iter_outer = 5,
    n_iter_seed = 3,
    Kappa = 5,
    p_mix = 0.85,
    Min_n = 200,
    setseed = 2026 + rep_id,
    Verbose = TRUE
  )

  res_phase_noprior <- res_phase_noprior %>%
    mutate(
      model = "No ZT prior",
      n_seed = 27,
      n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
      repeat_id = rep_id,
      benchmark = "no_ZT_prior"
    )

  saveRDS(res_phase_noprior, noprior_file)
  message("Saved No ZT-prior result: ", noprior_file)
}

rm(count)
gc()

# Step 5. Load standard ZT-prior result

res_phase_standard <- readRDS(standard_phase_file) %>%
  mutate(
    model = "ZT prior",
    n_seed = 27,
    n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
    repeat_id = rep_id,
    benchmark = "standard_ZT_prior"
  )

res_phase_noprior <- res_phase_noprior %>%
  mutate(
    model = "No ZT prior",
    n_seed = 27,
    n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
    repeat_id = rep_id,
    benchmark = "no_ZT_prior"
  )

res_phase_standard <- res_phase_standard[match(metadata$cell, res_phase_standard$cell), , drop = FALSE]
res_phase_noprior <- res_phase_noprior[match(metadata$cell, res_phase_noprior$cell), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(res_phase_standard$cell, metadata$cell))
stopifnot(identical(res_phase_noprior$cell, metadata$cell))

# Step 6. Build evaluation tables

eval_standard <- res_phase_standard %>%
  mutate(cell = as.character(cell)) %>%
  left_join(
    metadata %>%
      select(cell, t_true, theta_rad, ZT_sym, celltype),
    by = "cell"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(t_true), is.finite(ZT_pred)) %>%
  mutate(
    model = "ZT prior",
    ZT_pred_raw = ZT_pred,
    ZT_pred_aligned = ZT_pred
  )

eval_noprior <- res_phase_noprior %>%
  mutate(cell = as.character(cell)) %>%
  left_join(
    metadata %>%
      select(cell, t_true, theta_rad, ZT_sym, celltype),
    by = "cell"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(t_true), is.finite(ZT_pred)) %>%
  mutate(
    model = "No ZT prior",
    ZT_pred_raw = ZT_pred
  )

shift_noprior <- find_best_global_shift(
  true_h = eval_noprior$t_true,
  pred_h = eval_noprior$ZT_pred_raw,
  shift_grid = seq(0, 24, by = 0.01)
)

best_shift_h <- shift_noprior$shift_h[1]

message("Best global shift for No ZT prior: ", round(best_shift_h, 3), " h")

eval_noprior <- eval_noprior %>%
  mutate(ZT_pred_aligned = wrap24(ZT_pred_raw + best_shift_h))

eval_all <- bind_rows(eval_standard, eval_noprior) %>%
  mutate(
    abs_err_raw_h = circ_abs_err_h(pred_h = ZT_pred_raw, true_h = t_true),
    abs_err_aligned_h = circ_abs_err_h(pred_h = ZT_pred_aligned, true_h = t_true)
  )

write_csv(eval_all, file.path(out_dir, "no_ZT_prior_eval_cell_all.csv"))
saveRDS(eval_all, file.path(out_dir, "no_ZT_prior_eval_cell_all.rds"))

write_csv(shift_noprior, file.path(out_dir, "no_ZT_prior_best_global_shift.csv"))
saveRDS(shift_noprior, file.path(out_dir, "no_ZT_prior_best_global_shift.rds"))

# Step 7. Metrics

m_standard <- calc_phase_metrics(
  true_h = eval_standard$t_true,
  pred_h = eval_standard$ZT_pred_raw
)

m_noprior_raw <- calc_phase_metrics(
  true_h = eval_noprior$t_true,
  pred_h = eval_noprior$ZT_pred_raw
)

m_noprior_aligned <- calc_phase_metrics(
  true_h = eval_noprior$t_true,
  pred_h = eval_noprior$ZT_pred_aligned
)

metric_df <- tibble(
  model = c("ZT prior", "No ZT prior", "No ZT prior"),
  evaluation = c("standard", "unaligned", "aligned"),
  n_seed = 27,
  n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
  repeat_id = rep_id,
  global_shift_h = c(0, 0, best_shift_h),
  AUC = c(
    m_standard$AUC,
    m_noprior_raw$AUC,
    m_noprior_aligned$AUC
  ),
  MedAE = c(
    m_standard$MedAE,
    m_noprior_raw$MedAE,
    m_noprior_aligned$MedAE
  ),
  n_cell = c(
    m_standard$n_cell,
    m_noprior_raw$n_cell,
    m_noprior_aligned$n_cell
  )
)

print(metric_df)

write_csv(metric_df, file.path(out_dir, "no_ZT_prior_auc_medae.csv"))
saveRDS(metric_df, file.path(out_dir, "no_ZT_prior_auc_medae.rds"))

# Step 8. CDF curves

threshold_grid <- seq(0, 12, by = 0.05)

cdf_grid <- bind_rows(
  make_grid_cdf(
    true_h = eval_standard$t_true,
    pred_h = eval_standard$ZT_pred_raw,
    threshold_grid = threshold_grid
  ) %>%
    mutate(model = "ZT prior", evaluation = "standard"),

  make_grid_cdf(
    true_h = eval_noprior$t_true,
    pred_h = eval_noprior$ZT_pred_aligned,
    threshold_grid = threshold_grid
  ) %>%
    mutate(model = "No ZT prior", evaluation = "aligned")
) %>%
  mutate(
    n_seed = 27,
    n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
    repeat_id = rep_id
  ) %>%
  select(model, evaluation, n_seed, n_timepoint, repeat_id, threshold_h, pct_correct)

write_csv(cdf_grid, file.path(out_dir, "no_ZT_prior_cdf_grid.csv"))
saveRDS(cdf_grid, file.path(out_dir, "no_ZT_prior_cdf_grid.rds"))

# Step 9. Plot CDF

curve_labels <- c(
  "ZT prior | standard" = "ZT prior",
  "No ZT prior | aligned" = "No ZT prior"
)

curve_cols <- c(
  "ZT prior | standard" = "#A8C7E6",
  "No ZT prior | aligned" = "#357090"
)

curve_order <- names(curve_labels)

cdf_plot_df <- cdf_grid %>%
  mutate(curve = paste(model, evaluation, sep = " | "))

metric_plot_df <- metric_df %>%
  mutate(curve = paste(model, evaluation, sep = " | "))

legend_labels <- c()

for (curve_i in curve_order) {
  tmp <- metric_plot_df %>%
    filter(curve == curve_i)

  legend_labels <- c(
    legend_labels,
    paste0(
      curve_labels[curve_i],
      ": ",
      sprintf("%.3f", tmp$AUC),
      ", ",
      sprintf("%.3f", tmp$MedAE)
    )
  )
}

draw_cdf <- function() {
  par(
    family = "serif",
    mar = c(4, 4, 2.5, 1),
    mgp = c(2.1, 0.55, 0),
    tcl = -0.25,
    lwd = 0.5
  )

  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(-0.3, 12.5),
    ylim = c(-2, 102),
    xlab = "Correct to within (hrs)",
    ylab = paste0("% correct (N = ", nrow(metadata), ")"),
    main = "Absolute error CDF",
    cex.main = 0.9,
    cex.lab = 0.8,
    cex.axis = 0.75,
    bty = "n"
  )

  box(lwd = 0.5)
  abline(a = 0, b = 100 / 12, col = "lightgray", lwd = 0.7)

  for (curve_i in curve_order) {
    cdf_i <- cdf_plot_df %>%
      filter(curve == curve_i)

    lines(
      cdf_i$threshold_h,
      cdf_i$pct_correct,
      col = curve_cols[curve_i],
      lwd = 1.2
    )
  }

  legend(
    "bottomright",
    legend = c("        AUC, MedAE", legend_labels),
    col = c(NA, curve_cols[curve_order]),
    lwd = c(NA, rep(1.2, length(curve_order))),
    bty = "o",
    box.lwd = 0.3,
    cex = 0.66,
    y.intersp = 0.9
  )
}

tiff(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "no_ZT_prior_cell_phase_cdf.tiff"),
  width = 3.3,
  height = 3.2,
  units = "in",
  res = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)
draw_cdf()
dev.off()

pdf(
  file = file.path(plot_dir, "no_ZT_prior_cell_phase_cdf.pdf"),
  width = 3.3,
  height = 3.2
)
draw_cdf()
dev.off()
# Step 10. Scatter plots using package-style wrapper

res_phase_standard_plot <- res_phase_standard %>%
  mutate(ZT_pred_plot = ZT_pred)

res_phase_noprior_plot <- res_phase_noprior %>%
  mutate(ZT_pred_plot = eval_noprior$ZT_pred_aligned)

save_phase_scatter_with_wrapper(
  res_phase = res_phase_standard_plot,
  metadata = metadata,
  pred_by = "ZT_pred_plot",
  title_text = "ZT prior",
  point_col = "#A8C7E6",
  out_pdf = file.path(plot_dir, "ZT_prior_phase_scatter.pdf"),
  out_tiff = file.path(plot_dir, "ZT_prior_phase_scatter.tiff")
)

save_phase_scatter_with_wrapper(
  res_phase = res_phase_noprior_plot,
  metadata = metadata,
  pred_by = "ZT_pred_plot",
  title_text = "No ZT prior",
  point_col = "#357090",
  out_pdf = file.path(plot_dir, "No_ZT_prior_phase_scatter.pdf"),
  out_tiff = file.path(plot_dir, "No_ZT_prior_phase_scatter.tiff")
)

# Step 11. Save index and clean

index_df <- tibble(
  benchmark = "no_ZT_prior",
  n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
  repeat_id = rep_id,
  object_file = obj_file,
  standard_phase_file = standard_phase_file,
  noprior_phase_file = noprior_file,
  metric_file = file.path(out_dir, "no_ZT_prior_auc_medae.csv"),
  cdf_file = file.path(out_dir, "no_ZT_prior_cdf_grid.csv"),
  eval_file = file.path(out_dir, "no_ZT_prior_eval_cell_all.csv"),
  best_global_shift_h = best_shift_h,
  status = "finished"
)

write_csv(index_df, file.path(index_dir, "no_ZT_prior_file_index.csv"))
saveRDS(index_df, file.path(index_dir, "no_ZT_prior_file_index.rds"))

rm(
  obj_sim,
  metadata,
  res_phase_standard,
  res_phase_noprior,
  res_phase_standard_plot,
  res_phase_noprior_plot,
  eval_standard,
  eval_noprior,
  eval_all,
  cdf_grid,
  cdf_plot_df,
  metric_plot_df
)
gc()

message("Finished No ZT-prior ablation.")
message("Output directory: ", out_dir)
message("Plots: ", plot_dir)
```
